lengthRules.signature: byte0 low-nibble 0xf AND byte+1==0x80 AND byte+2==0x86
lengthRules.evidence: anchored-resync brute force across 76 own-compiled intersection_query occurrences: only L=8 re-tokenizes the following ops (471 clean follow-on ops vs <=100 for L in {4,6,10,12}). Absorbs the trailing `0f 22 82` (its own bytes +4..+7), which is why round-1 saw spurious `0f 22 82` desyncs.
clean bracketing (iunary -> fldexp -> device_store -> stop) in float_arith__ldexp & transcendental__ldexp; whole kernel tokenizes clean at L=6.

descriptors.semantics: 8-byte special op emitted only inside intersection_query traversal / committed+candidate result getters. byte0 HIGH nibble = dst register; byte+1=0x80, byte+2=0x86 (SFU/special-function datapath marker, same 0x86 the 0x2f/0xaf fspecial family carries), byte+5=0x22, byte+6=0x82 constant. byte+4 low-nibble 7 vs f is a 1-bit selector; byte+3/byte+7 are operand selectors. The trailing `[07|0f] 22 82 ZZ` (bytes +4..+7) is the SECOND HALF of THIS instruction, not a separate 0x0f op -- this is why the round-1 census reported spurious `0f 22 82 ..` / `bf 80 86 ..` / `ff 80 86 ..` desyncs. Internal operand semantics left structural (clean-room: encoding documented, the getter algorithm is not lifted).
descriptors.provenance: structural (inferred) + LENGTH byte-diff (EXP-M4-13 R2, own-MSL): length 8 established by anchored resync across 76 occurrences in 5 own-compiled intersection_query shaders (rq_bary/rq_dist/rq_xform + the two query-getter corpus kernels) -- only length 8 lets the following 0x0a compare / 0f05 push / 9f01 iadd ops re-tokenize (471 clean follow-on ops vs <=100 for 4/6/10/12). Constant bytes +1/+2/+5/+6 and dst=byte0-hi read directly off the 76 samples. NOT HW-dispatch-validated (no GPU splice run in R2).

descriptors.semantics: fldexp: d = ldexp(a, n) = a * 2^n for a RUNTIME integer exponent n (float scale-by-power-of-two). byte0 low-nibble 0xf, high-nibble = dst; byte+1=0x15 sub-op, byte+2=0x80 constant; byte+3 = operand descriptor (source float / exponent register). Only emitted for the dynamic-exponent ldexp -- the constant-exponent form folds to an fmul by a power-of-two literal.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff (EXP-M4-13 R2, own-MSL): length 6 proven by clean bracketing (iunary@170 -> fldexp -> device_store@184 -> stop, whole ldexp kernel tokenizes clean). Emission gated to dynamic exponent shown by compiling ldexp(v,3)/ldexp(v,5)/ldexp(v,-2) (constant-folded, NO 0f15 op) vs ldexp(v,n) (emits it). byte+3 operand localized by a 3x-ldexp regalloc-variation kernel (0x08->0x16->0x10). NOT HW-dispatch-validated.

descriptors.semantics: d = simd/quad reduce or prefix-scan of src over the SIMD-group (scope=1, width 32) or 2x2 quad (scope=0). Operation = (byte0 bit7, byte+1): byte+1=0x00 {and(bit7=0), or(1)}; 0x01 {xor(0), add/iadd(1)}; 0x03 {?, umax(1)}; 0x05 {?, fmin(1)}; 0x06 {FADD/simd_sum(0), FMUL/simd_product(1) -- NEW EXP-O2D, HW-splice byte0 0xbf->0x3f flips product 1.0 -> sum 32.0}; 0x07 {?, fmax(1)}; 0x02 {max/min}. byte+7 = datatype/shape: 0x03 int add|and|or|xor reduce, 0x07 int min|max, 0x12 float reduce, 0x0b int exclusive-scan, 0x09 int inclusive-scan, 0x32 FLOAT exclusive-scan (NEW), float inclusive-scan = the exclusive-scan followed by a 0x09 float op of the lane's own value. NB INTEGER simd_product / prefix-product have NO native reduce op -- they LOWER to a log2(32)-step shuffle(0x47)+multiply(0x9f) tree (only FLOAT product/prefix-product use this native op; the reduce unit has a float-mul mode but no int-mul mode).
descriptors.provenance: HW-VALIDATED (EXP-0018 + EXP-O2D): all ops run with a distinct per-lane value and read back per-lane (sum/min/max/and/or/xor/prod/fsum/prefix all exact, width 32). Splice-proven op-select: byte0 bf->3f flips or->and; byte+1 01->02 & byte+7 03->07 flips sum->max; byte+7 0b->03 flips exclusive-scan->full-reduce; EXP-O2D byte0 0xbf->0x3f flips 32-lane float product 1.0 -> sum 32.0 (byte+1=0x06 bit7=1 = simd_product). quad byte0 b7/37 (bit3=0) proven by q_* semantics.

descriptors.semantics: d = src from another lane. byte0 0x47 = broadcast / shuffle-up / fill_up, 0xc7 = shuffle-xor / shuffle-down / fill_down (bit7 = direction). byte+1 mode: 0x04 SIMD-group shuffle, 0x00 quad, 0x06 rotate / shuffle_and_fill (NEW EXP-O2D). byte+6 = source lane index (broadcast) or xor mask (shuffle_xor), encoded (value<<1). simd_broadcast_first & dynamic simd_shuffle(v,lane) use the same op with the lane index in a register. NEW (EXP-O2D): simd_shuffle_and_fill_up/down = byte+1==0x06; the FILL DATA is a SEPARATE operand loaded by a preceding 0x67 device_load before the shuffle. The modulo/rotate variant (v, fill, delta, modulo) is the same byte+1==0x06 op with byte+6 changed (fill 0x4a -> modulo 0x42) plus a tail byte (0x20 -> 0x30) carrying the modulo. simd_shuffle_up/down add edge-handling predication (0f80/0f9e) around the core op; simd_shuffle_xor is a single clean op.
descriptors.provenance: HW-VALIDATED (EXP-0018 + RT-ISA-FIX): broadcast(0/5), broadcast_first, shuffle_xor(1), shuffle(dyn), shuffle_up/down, rotate_up/down and the quad equivalents all run with distinct per-lane inputs and read back exactly. byte+6=(lane<<1) proven (bcast5 -> 0x0a, bcast lane2 quad -> 0x04, xor1 -> 0x02). mode/dir byte-diff-localized (simd 0x04 vs quad 0x00; 0x47 vs 0xc7). RT-ISA-FIX re-proved on HW: `simd_broadcast(lane*10+5,3)`=35 all lanes (bytes 47 04 54 ..) and `simd_shuffle_xor(v,3)`=(lane^3)*10+5 (c7 04 54 ..) -- both carry byte+2==0x54, which the old 0x56-only gate rejected; the relaxed match now decodes them.

simd_shuffle.mode(byte+1)._note: low nibble = op class; bit4(0x10)=dynamic register index/delta; bit3(0x08)=fragment quad; byte0 bit7=dir

notes: REDUCE op-select is a JOINT encoding: byte+1(op) + byte0.bit7(opcls, picks within the op-pair) + byte+7(dtype=width/reduce-vs-scan). Integer add=op1; int min/max split signed(op2)/unsigned(op3); FLOAT add/mul split by WIDTH into op4(half)/op6(f32); float min=op5,max=op7 (width-independent, width in dtype). This fully maps the previously-unmapped op=0x04 and the f16 dtypes 0x08/0x10/0x13/0x18.

SHUFFLE mode(byte+1): low nibble = op class, bit4(0x10)=DYNAMIC (register) index/delta, bit3(0x08)=fragment-stage quad variant; byte0 bit7(dir) picks bcast/up/rotate_up vs xor/down/rotate_down. Adds modes 0x01,0x05,0x08,0x10,0x14,0x15.

rt_query_traverse: 8-byte low-nibble-f op unique to intersection_query traversal/getters. High-nibble=dst; byte+1/+2/+5/+6 constant (0x80/0x86/0x22/0x82); byte+2==0x86 is the SFU/special-function datapath marker shared with 0x2f/0xaf fspecial. Internal operand semantics LEFT STRUCTURAL on purpose -- naming them would reconstruct the compiler getter sequence (clean-room rule 5). We document the ENCODING/length only.
fldexp (0f 15 80): runtime ldexp(float,int) = float * 2^n. Constant-exponent ldexp constant-folds to fmul (no op emitted).

0x5f: per task, NOT re-decoded -- it is already the named rt_ray_mem memory op (byte+2 in {0x54,0x56} -> 14B). The `5f 02 ..` census desyncs are resync artifacts inside RT kernels (byte+2 not a memory marker), not a new op.

0x8f: already the named `ret` (4B). The `8f 04 56` / `8f 10 02` census gaps are mid-stream resync artifacts (best-resync L=4 is dominated by hundreds of coincidental mid-instruction 0x8f bytes; 0x8f's real semantic is function-return, which does not fit a reduce marker). NOT decoded to a new op -- reported UNRESOLVED.

Residual low-nibble-f census desync leaders (corpus-wide ~2168): overwhelmingly resync artifacts, NOT new ops. Breakdown: 0xff `ff ff`/`ff 00` (~612) = end-of-shader PADDING/alignment fill; 0x0f/0x3f inside the INTEGER simd_product / prefix-scan tree (`0f 2f XX 86 ..` = fspecial tails mis-aligned by the unowned log2(32) shuffle+multiply scaffolding); 0x5f `5f 02` inside RT traversal (byte+2 not a memory marker). These sit in unowned families (0x9f mul-tree, 0x0a/0x2a compares, 0xbb/0xdb/0xeb ray ops, half-relational) and cannot be bracketed from the low-nibble-f family alone.
